scope.decision_supported: Evidence input for placement judge v2 rubric and evaluation design.
scope.included: Every raw row, structured answer, top-level comment, and per-variant question_comments value in the four supplied human-annotated reports, plus four newer direct user FAIL adjudications.
scope.excluded: The printer guidance report is authored training/guidance material, not a human annotation submission.
scope.storage_preflight: PASS: checkout resolves under backed-up /home/colligo/hs_scripts; /mnt/localssd was not used.

live_s3_annotation_check.method: Read-only aws s3api list-objects-v2 on each included report's annotations/ prefix; no object was downloaded or overwritten.
live_s3_annotation_check.result: MATCH: five live annotation objects have the same keys and byte sizes as the five preserved local files; no additional or newer reviewer object was present.

summary.correction_to_prior_inventory: The prior inventory counted only 29 top-level comments. It omitted the 63 nonempty per-variant question_comments values in zperkins's HP16 V13-vs-V14 submission, including mixed multiline values. The complete raw-schema audit contains 92 nonempty text annotations before the four newer direct user labels.

evidence_rules: Structured best-of-four, overall-preference, fidelity, realism, lighting, and blue-element votes are preserved but never converted to placement pass/fail ground truth.
Per-variant question_comments fields have exact variant attribution, but broad Good/OK text is not a placement pass unless the source explicitly says placement passed.
An unqualified top-level comment on a two-output row has comparison-set-ambiguous attribution. A single-output row or an explicitly named variant has exact attribution.
Mixed comments are split into exact quoted clauses; non-placement clauses remain present and separately classified.
Empty comment fields are unlabeled, not passes.
The four latest user FAIL adjudications are the strongest evidence and remain distinct from the older report corpus; their short descriptive labels are paraphrases, not verbatim user quotations.
